# Sending Jobs to Production

When you upload artwork to a job yourself, OrderHub holds the job back. This gives you time to add all the files, even across several batches. OrderHub Desktop only downloads the job once you **send it to production**. You can do that from three places.

![Release Jobs via Production Board](https://nazkcvruighrhpgcarxg.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/help-documentation-images/e4a57d51-130a-41fc-9cb0-5e595caf42c8.png)

---

## Which jobs are held

| Job type | What happens |
|---|---|
| Orders created by hand, at the till or through an API, once artwork has been uploaded | **Held** until you send them to production |
| Online orders and automatically created jobs (for example film scans) | **Sent to production automatically.** You don't need to do anything |
| Any job whose process has **Hold for Production Routing** turned on | **Held** so someone can confirm the print location |

* Note: Turning on **Hold for Production Routing** only affects new jobs. Jobs already in progress are not held.

---

## 1. From the Upload Artwork window

After the upload finishes, the window shows **Artwork uploaded** with three choices:

1. **Add more files** – upload another batch. The copy count carries on from the copies you've already uploaded.
2. **Send to Production** – send the job now.
3. **Done** – close the window and leave the job held so you can come back later.

If the copies you've assigned don't match the **Quantity ordered**, OrderHub warns you. You can still send the job once you confirm.

![Continue Uploading or Send to Production](https://nazkcvruighrhpgcarxg.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/help-documentation-images/b0c6b1fb-eb17-4fec-a5f0-f5e4f83e6e1b.png)

---

## 2. From the job's artwork section

1. Open the order and go to the job's **Original Artwork Files**.
2. A held job shows the **Held — not released to production** badge.
3. Click **Send to Production**.

Once the job is sent, the badge changes to **Released → {Location} — uploads locked**. You can no longer upload artwork to that job.

---

## 3. From the Production Board

A job with uploaded artwork that hasn't been sent yet stands out on the board in three ways:

* an amber edge on the card
* a **Needs Release** label next to the job number
* a small amber **Release** button

Click **Release** to open the same Send to Production window. Once the job is sent, the amber marking disappears.

![Release Jobs via Production Board](https://nazkcvruighrhpgcarxg.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/help-documentation-images/836c3e15-ce67-4dce-b0c6-9fbfbd0c4a6e.png)

---

## The Send to Production window

* **One location:** the window shows "Releasing to **{location}**". Click **Send to Production**.
* **Several locations:** choose from **Production Location**. The usual location is marked **(default)**. If you pick a different one, you'll see "Overriding the default location for this job."
* If the process holds jobs, a message explains that the process is set to **Hold for production routing**.

Afterwards you'll see **Sent to production**. OrderHub Desktop picks the job up the next time it checks for new work.

---

## Good to know

* You send jobs one at a time. There is no way to send several at once.
* You can change the location after sending, but only until OrderHub Desktop has downloaded the job.
* Jobs from online orders can't have artwork uploaded by hand. Their files come from the order.
